spec_match.rationale: Implements the explainer's own drag-to-snap divider scenario with the exact recommended pattern — navigator.playHaptics?.('align', 0.8) fired once on entering the snap band, reset on leaving — and reproduces the explainer's code verbatim.

interactive.rationale: Pointer-capture drag plus full keyboard operation (arrows, Shift+arrows, Home/End) move the real divider; every snap attempt lands in a call log; readouts, aria-valuenow and the live status all track position.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Card promises drag/arrow-key operation with an honest executed-or-skipped log, which matches the page.

edge_cases.rationale: API-absent degrades to the explainer's silent optional-chaining no-op with the skip logged explicitly; re-entry fires again (per interaction, not once ever); the vibrate add-on logs its real boolean and its own absence case.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5167864517623808 and the explainer's Drag-to-Snap scenario.

conformance.rationale: The suite's returns-undefined and clamp assertions cover this page's call shape ('align', 0.8); suite verified executing on /conformance/.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Playwright-driven headless Chromium 141: keyboard-only run — 15×ArrowRight snapped at 50% (aria-valuenow 50, status announced the skip branch), wiggle out to 46% unsnapped, re-entry logged a second attempt (2 calls, 2 log lines); ?autorun=1 walk-in state screenshotted; zero console errors; both viewport classes read, overflow 0.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts the load probe, the api-absent branch, and on first snap either the real-call or the skip branch; a thrown call asserts false.

design_system.rationale: Tokens only; the divider's focus-visible outline uses --accent-blue; snapped state recolors the handle; readout chips are stone-on-charcoal pairs that pass AA.

accessibility.rationale: The divider is a real button with role=separator, aria-orientation, aria-valuemin/max/now, a descriptive accessible name, aria-describedby to the live status, and visible focus; the log is a labelled reversed list; snap announcements are polite and only on state change, so dragging does not spam the screen reader.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: touch-action:none on the drag surfaces makes pointer dragging work on touch; the 20px hit strip plus keyboard path covers fine control on mobile; measured overflow 0 at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×800, both screenshots read.

openQuestions.title: Confirm snap haptic timing feel on real hardware
openQuestions.detail: On a WebHaptics-enabled Windows 11 24H2 machine with a haptic touchpad, verify the align pulse lands at the visual snap moment during a fast drag (the call is fire-and-forget; any perceived latency would be platform-side and worth noting on the page).

guidanceConsulted.query: keyboard accessible draggable separator slider pattern
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Custom drag widgets need an equivalent keyboard path, correct role/value semantics, and visible focus.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The divider is a native button with role=separator + aria-valuenow/min/max, arrow/Home/End handling, and a focus-visible outline; verified by driving it entirely from the keyboard in the browser.

guidanceConsulted.query: announce state change without flooding aria-live during continuous drag
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce after meaningful state changes rather than every input event.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The aria-live status updates only on snap/unsnap transitions and discrete keyboard steps, while per-pixel drag positions update non-live readout chips.

guidanceConsulted.query: split pane layout that stays usable at 360px
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use flex with min-width:0 panes so both sides stay visible and nothing overflows.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Panes are flex items with min-width:0 and overflow:hidden; measured 0 horizontal page overflow at 360×740 DPR3.

summary: Practical product concept straight from the explainer: a genuinely draggable, keyboard-operable split divider whose snap moment attempts the real align haptic and logs executed vs skipped truthfully on every attempt.
